description: Turn 13 at Dol Guldur: Dwar the Ringwraith shares a company with four non-Ringwraiths, and Bûrat is Dwar's follower, so splitting Dwar off takes Bûrat with him and still leaves a mixed company (CoE 2.II.2.1.R3). From bug report 23d75d5a00096d79 (game mw4o7cmo-95owwb), where the modular AI kept the company together from turn 11 on and it never left Dol Guldur.
expectation: Un-stack Bûrat to general influence (then split Dwar off), rather than pass.
